stories.h: Nvidia to invest $1 billion in Naver for 4.5% stake, deepening AI factory alliance
stories.s: The deal ties Nvidia to Naver’s AI ambitions and could influence how joint AI work unfolds in the ecosystem around both companies.
b: WSJ framing: investment tied to Naver's AI Project
body: Nvidia plans to invest $1 billion in Naver for a 4.5% stake, a move described by KedGlobal as deepening an AI factory alliance between the two companies.
The Wall Street Journal also covered the development, noting the investment is connected to Naver’s AI Project.
Details on how the funds will be used, governance structures, or timing were not disclosed in the coverage provided.
Both outlets frame the investment as part of a broader collaboration around artificial intelligence, with the alliance described in varying terms but centered on joint AI initiatives.
No further timeline or operational specifics were included in the reports.
